why: Sharks, Humans and Blood (pilot, 2026-11-14): more Sharks and Humans for Shabraz's flying and Brallin's trample, and a Blood-token line — a Blood activation discards (Brallin: counter, ping) and draws (Shabraz: counter, life), and Jaws pings again on the sacrifice. Strong and uncompromising: nothing given up unless it buys something bigger.

summary.title: Sharks, Humans and Blood: both commanders fed by every Blood token
summary.blurb: Adds Jaws and two more Sharks, two Humans, and a Blood-token line: each Blood token discards for Brallin and draws for Shabraz, and Jaws pings on every sacrifice; pays with a damage tripler, a counter booster, three rocks and a re-cut mana base.
